name: Reptiscale Growth Machine

positioning.oneLine: Reptiscale turns a reptile seller into a complete online business: store, CRM, content, checkout, safe shipping, care follow-up, reviews, referrals, and repeat buyers.
positioning.primaryBuyer: Mid-tier reptile breeders and exotic animal sellers who sell through shows, social media, MorphMarket, and direct messages.
positioning.corePromise: Every buyer gets captured, followed up with, sold to, shipped safely, educated, and invited back.

lifecycleStages.label: Brand Discovery
lifecycleStages.goal: A prospect finds the breeder through social, show QR, website, MorphMarket, referral, or search.

lifecycleStages.label: Lead Capture
lifecycleStages.goal: Capture contact details and species/budget interest with a clear reason to opt in.

lifecycleStages.label: Nurture
lifecycleStages.goal: Educate the buyer, build trust, and show animals that match their interest.

lifecycleStages.label: Offer
lifecycleStages.goal: Move the buyer toward a specific offer: animal reservation, care starter kit, consultation, or waitlist.

lifecycleStages.label: Purchase
lifecycleStages.goal: Collect deposit or full payment and move the buyer into fulfillment.

lifecycleStages.label: Safe Shipping
lifecycleStages.goal: Check weather, decide ship/hold, communicate clearly, and protect live arrival.

lifecycleStages.label: Care Onboarding
lifecycleStages.goal: Help the customer receive and settle the animal correctly.

lifecycleStages.label: Advocacy
lifecycleStages.goal: Turn safe arrivals into reviews, referrals, user-generated content, and public proof.

lifecycleStages.label: Repeat Buyer
lifecycleStages.goal: Keep buyers engaged with future availability, waitlists, seasonal drops, and breeder updates.

leadMagnets.title: Crested Gecko Starter Guide

leadMagnets.title: Show VIP Availability List
leadMagnets.promise: First look at animals before they are posted publicly, plus show-only pickup offers.
leadMagnets.followUpOffer: Book a show pickup or place a deposit

offers.name: Animal Reservation Deposit
offers.goal: Hold a specific animal while weather, pickup, or buyer details are confirmed.

offers.name: Crested Gecko Care Starter Kit
offers.goal: Increase order value and help the new owner prepare properly.

offers.name: 30-Minute Setup Review
offers.goal: Let the breeder review enclosure setup before the animal ships.

offers.name: Next-Clutch Waitlist
offers.goal: Keep non-buyers engaged until a better match is available.
